mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of social organization where people move from one place to another in search of natural resources for their survival."
Normadism on the other hand is a form of social organization where people move from one place to another in search of natural resources for their survival.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of interrelated, interacting and interdependent elements acting together for a common purpose and capable of reacting as a whole to external stimuli."
A system is a set of interrelated, interacting and interdependent elements acting together for a common purpose and capable of reacting as a whole to external stimuli.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of land utilization which features the grazing of livestock rather than the cultivation of crops."
Pastoralism is a system of land utilization which features the grazing of livestock rather than the cultivation of crops.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the adoption of improved crop rotations and cultivation practices for other crops."
An interesting byproduct is the adoption of improved crop rotations and cultivation practices for other crops.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to growing crops in sequence within a crop year, one crop being sown after the harvest of the other."
Sequential cropping refers to growing crops in sequence within a crop year, one crop being sown after the harvest of the other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount of water vapor the air can hold at any given temperature."
Relative Humidity (RH) is the amount of water vapor the air can hold at any given temperature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a widespread cropping practice in the tropics."
Mixed cropping or intercropping is a widespread cropping practice in the tropics.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as a diagnostic process, providing a collection of methods for researchers to understand farm households and their decision-making."
Farming Systems Research (FSR) may be defined as a diagnostic process, providing a collection of methods for researchers to understand farm households and their decision-making.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method of multiple cropping where one crop is seeded into standing second crop well before harvesting of second crop."
Relay cropping is a method of multiple cropping where one crop is seeded into standing second crop well before harvesting of second crop.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the largest semi-nomadic group in the world found across west and central Africa."
The Fulani are the largest semi-nomadic group in the world found across west and central Africa.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a set of strategies put in place to manage available resources to achieve economic and sustainable agricultural productivity thereby meeting the needs of farm households."

Agricultural farming systems are a set of strategies put in place to manage available resources to achieve economic and sustainable agricultural productivity thereby meeting the needs of farm households.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the oldest type of nomad."
Hunter-gatherers are the oldest type of nomad.
fib: ______ is an integrated set of activities that farmers perform in their farms under their resources and circumstances to maximize productivity and net farm income on a sustainable basis.
farming system
A farming system is an integrated set of activities that farmers perform in their farms under their resources and circumstances to maximize productivity and net farm income on a sustainable basis.

Normadic

farm
